name: Rohan Mehta
title: MERN Stack Developer
summary: MERN Stack Developer with 2 years of experience building and shipping web and mobile applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js. Skilled in React Native (Expo) for cross-platform mobile development, with multiple live apps on both iOS and Android. Currently pursuing BCA to strengthen core computer science fundamentals alongside hands-on industry experience.

bullets: Working as a MERN Stack Developer, handling both frontend and backend development for live production applications.
Contributing to end-to-end feature development using React, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Developed and maintained responsive frontend interfaces using React.js.
Worked closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and improve UI performance.
Built full-stack web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.
Learned and applied React Native (Expo) to develop and deploy cross-platform mobile applications.
Worked on live projects including Office Management System, Stock Management System, and Jain Social Group Online, along with their companion mobile apps (React Native, Expo).
